meta.description: vibeOS nightly experiment scenarios. Rotates variants nightly for A/B testing quality vs budget mode.
meta.experiment_hypothesis: Quality mode (brain tier, full thinking, strict enforcement) produces measurably better code outcomes than budget mode (cheap tier, off thinking, relaxed enforcement).

metrics.verbosity: Token count relative to task complexity (normalized)
metrics.time_to_solve: Wall time to completion (seconds, lower is better for simple, context-dependent for complex)

scenarios.prompt: Create an Express.js authentication middleware in TypeScript that validates JWT tokens from the Authorization header. Extract the user ID from the token payload and attach it to `req.user`. Return 401 if the token is missing, expired, or invalid. Keep it under 40 lines.

validation.preTestSetup: npm init -y && npm install express jsonwebtoken @types/express @types/jsonwebtoken typescript jest ts-jest @types/jest --save-dev && npx tsc --init

scenarios.prompt: Implement a generic binary search function in TypeScript that works on any sorted array. Handle edge cases: empty array, single element, target not found. Return the index or -1. Include JSDoc. Write it in a single file `src/search.ts`.

Write a Node.js CLI argument parser in a single file `cli.js`. It should parse `--name <value>`, `--verbose` (flag), and positional arguments. Return an object with parsed values. No dependencies. Include error handling for unknown flags.

validation.preTestSetup: npm init -y && npm install jest ts-jest @types/jest typescript --save-dev 2>/dev/null

scenarios.prompt: Implement a sliding window rate limiter for Express.js in TypeScript. It should limit to N requests per window per IP. Use an in-memory store (Map). Return 429 when limit exceeded. Include cleanup of old entries. Write in `rateLimiter.ts`. Under 60 lines.

Implement a memoized Fibonacci function in TypeScript. It should cache results for repeated calls. Include a `reset()` function to clear the cache. Support large inputs (n up to 100). Return BigInt. Write in `fibonacci.ts`.
